understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+' at the same time, completing all levels in sequence.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action in pixel coordinates, while walls can block movement and adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed. Movement blocking indicators are only hints, so actions must be tested. When multiple selectable pieces exist, CLICK at a piece's coordinate switches which piece receives movement commands; every goal must be occupied for the level to report WIN.
